acceptedAnswer.text: Gennit AI is an intelligent media design platform powered by artificial intelligence that enables users to create stunning graphics, videos, animations, brand assets, and marketing visuals without requiring design skills.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free trial available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Gennit AI offers a free Basic plan that allows individuals, startups, and small teams to access professional AI media design tools.

mainEntity.name: How can I get started with Gennit AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply sign up on our website with your email address or Google account, and you'll have immediate access to start creating AI-powered media designs.

mainEntity.name: What types of media can I create?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Gennit AI, you can create graphics, videos, animations, brand assets, marketing visuals, social media content, presentations, and more.

mainEntity.name: Do I need design experience to use Gennit?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Gennit AI is designed to be user-friendly for everyone, regardless of their design background. Our AI handles the complex design work for you.
